source_name: Order of the Minister of Health of the Republic of Uzbekistan No. 34 of 21 August 2023, registered by the Ministry of Justice on 31 August 2023 as No. 3455. Annex, essential medicines list. International nonproprietary name, form and strength as the annex prints them.
what_is_counted: Every numbered row of the annex. Not a ranking by prescriptions. No brand beyond a parenthetical the annex itself prints. The Cyrillic line is the letter-by-letter rule applied to the annex spelling. The Russian line is that Cyrillic line with the four letters only Uzbek uses replaced so a Russian sentence can hold it. A pharmacist has not read the spellings.
licence_note: Machine reading of Law of the Republic of Uzbekistan No. OʻRQ-42 of 20 July 2006, articles 5 and 8 (https://lex.uz/en/acts/-1022944): an official document is not an object of copyright, and a method is not one either. Not a lawyer's opinion.
